title: Red Hat Security Advisory: redhat-ds:12 security, bug fix, and enhancement update
description: CVE-2026-19843 is a command injection vulnerability in Red Hat Directory Server 12.9 for RHEL 9, specifically via unescaped LDAP Distinguished Names (DN) in the Cockpit 389 Console LDAP editor. This vulnerability allows an attacker to execute arbitrary commands due to improper input handling. Red Hat has issued an important security update addressing this issue.
